entries.english:
Hiltgunt von Steinsfeld assigns an annual rent to the convent at Gnadental, secured on her farm at Steinsfeld (Kochersteinsfeld).
Issued at an unspecified place, 25 October 1325 (Friday before Simon and Jude).
Parchment; seal: Adelheid von Uissigheim.

Date range: 1325

Extent: 1 document
